lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: is this a good time for you?
What's up?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Eunhwa said that

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: darts can be effective training to improve your accuracy,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: so we're going to go play a few rounds.
Ooh, darts are fun!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I knew you'd played it before!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: It was my first time, so I didn't know the rules T_T

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I asked Eunhwa,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: and she told me to just hurl the dart

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: toward the middle of the dartboard.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: She said the rules were simple and wanted to start playing straight away.
That's all she told you?
That's just the fundamentals.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I suppose.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I followed Eunhwa's lead

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: and threw the dart the way she did, but...

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: T_T
It was your first try, so it must have been tough.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Well...
Did you at least hit the dartboard?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Eunhwa's dart was already in the middle,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: so that is where I sent mine.
You mean you got a bullseye?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Well, sort of. It went through the tail of Eunhwa's dart.
Whoa!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: And the dart after that, and after that as well.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I kept splitting Eunhwa's darts which were already in the center of the board.
Did Eunhwa say anything?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: She said

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: she was a fool for thinking that

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: she could beat me,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: and then stormed off.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Do you think she got annoyed that I didn't know the rules?
I can assure you that's not it.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Could you teach me how to play darts,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Commander?
If anything, it sounds like you should be teaching me.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Please? T_T

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I'm a fast learner.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I'll head over to the Commander's Room right now.
... Okay.
I better avoid giving her any demonstrations.
